t: Forge Steel mixed angle screwdriver set delivers comprehensive fastening solutions with 112 pieces covering all fastener types. The extensive collection includes 13 standard screwdrivers, 2 VDE insulating options, 6 precision screwdrivers, 16 hex keys, 6 nut driver bits, 48 interchangeable bits, 20 precision bits and a precision bit driver. Manufactured from strong, durable chrome vanadium steel with magnetised tips, to ensure secure fastening and reduced frustration on site. Contoured, rubberised soft-grip handles provide excellent comfort and control during extended use, with reduced hand fatigue.
